sections.content: A lo largo de tracks a demographic trend across time; a raíz de and como consecuencia de both draw out what followed from that trend. Used together, they let a paragraph move from 'this kept happening' to 'and because of that, the system had to respond'. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A lo largo del periodo colonial, la mezcla entre poblaciones avanzó de forma constante.
items.english: Throughout the colonial period, mixing between populations advanced steadily.

items.spanish: A raíz de esta realidad demográfica, el sistema legal de castas se volvió cada vez más difícil de sostener.
items.english: As a result of this demographic reality, the legal caste system became increasingly hard to sustain.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia de esa tensión, la corona terminó recurriendo a una solución tan insólita como reveladora.
items.english: As a consequence of that tension, the crown ended up resorting to a solution as unusual as it was revealing.

items.spanish: A lo largo de estas últimas décadas coloniales, la desigualdad no disminuyó a pesar del aumento de la mezcla.
items.english: Throughout these final colonial decades, inequality didn't decrease despite the increase in mixing.

sections.content: Notice a lo largo de opens and closes this whole argument (colonial period... final colonial decades) while a raíz de / como consecuencia de sit in the middle, marking the turning points. That's a common shape for a formal historical paragraph: time-span, cause, time-span again.
